span.description: Fraction for lowess/loess; supply this OR detrend_window.

parent_run_id.description: Completed parent of the same analysis operation. Use acycle_rerun for conversational adjustments; a different operation starts independently without parent_run_id.

endpoint_policy.description: Default trim retains only the control-point interval. Extrapolation is explicit and recorded.
